name: menu
gotchas: A `mat-menu` renders nothing on its own — it must be opened by a trigger element bound with `[matMenuTriggerFor]`; the menu's template only enters the DOM (inside the CDK overlay container) once opened.

Nested menus require the submenu's trigger item to itself specify `[matMenuTriggerFor]` pointing at the child `mat-menu` — placing a `mat-menu` inside another `mat-menu`'s template without that binding won't open it as a submenu.

Clicking a `mat-menu-item` closes the menu automatically; if the click handler is asynchronous, the menu is already closed by the time the handler resolves, so "still open" UI feedback needs to live outside the menu.
